notes.title: 🚀 Ready for Space Exploration Fest? 🚀
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 Ready for Space Exploration Fest? 🚀[/h1]

[h3]No Ticket Back: Craft, Survive & Escape is joining the Steam Space Exploration Fest with a thrilling new update![/h3]

Step into the terrifying world of No Ticket Back, a unique blend of horror, roguelike strategy, and survival. This game combines elements of zombie survival, tower defense, RPG, crafting, building, and colony management to deliver a spine-chilling experience unlike any other.

[h3]🛸 Embark on a Harrowing Odyssey:[/h3]

The SS McCalister's Hope: Once a symbol of humanity’s aspirations for Mars, the SS McCalister's Hope now drifts through space as a haunted vessel. Its corridors echo with the moans of the undead and the whispers of a doomed crew.
Survive the Nightmare: With the ship overrun by a relentless zombie apocalypse, every decision could mean the difference between life and death. Manage resources, fortify your defenses, and craft weapons to fend off the undead.
Escape the Ghostly Ship: As the crew battles both physical and psychological horrors, the ultimate goal is to escape the clutches of this cursed vessel. But will they survive long enough to see another sunrise?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921072/66451281e6f272b3e56f12101516d112334fa206.png[/img]

[h3]🎮 Game Highlights:[/h3]

Roguelike Elements: Each playthrough is unique, with procedurally generated challenges that test your strategy and survival skills.
Crafting & Building: Gather resources, craft essential items, and build structures to improve your chances of survival.
Colony Management: Lead your crew, make tough decisions, and ensure the survival of as many members as possible.
Tower Defense Mechanics: Fortify your position and defend against waves of undead using strategically placed defenses.
Prepare for a journey filled with dread, strategy, and the fight for survival in space. Will you and your crew find a way to escape, or will the SS McCalister's Hope become your eternal tomb? 🚀👻

[h3]Stay tuned for more updates during the Space Exploration Fest![/h3]

WISHLIST NOW!

notes.title: Demo update 1.041 is here!
notes.content:
Update & Changes in this Demo update:

Adjusted day & night cycle for better balance and immersion.
Enhanced enemy AI and pathfinding for smarter adversaries.
Money Crates now respawn for continuous resource gathering.
Increased currency yield from crystal deposits for greater rewards.
Optimized colonists' movements and speeds for smoother gameplay.
